limitations: Partial automation: molecules and plain text only; arrows, brackets, images, rich-text runs and explicit atom/bond overrides need manual review.

Verified for Cell via its Final submission page linking this shared guide. These settings concern final production, not initial peer review. Graphical abstracts and Leading Edge artwork are outside this profile.
Existing coordinates and bond angles are retained unless resizing is explicitly selected. Terminal-carbon labels and implicit-hydrogen display preferences are not changed.
The guide lists separate stereo-bond width 0.056 cm. ChemDraft does not expose an independent stereo-width setting in this operation; verify wedge/hash appearance manually.
Chemical-specific bond width 0.015 cm (about 0.425 pt) differs from the general artwork advice of 0.5–1.5 pt. This profile uses the explicit chemical value; confirm any editorial exceptions.
Column widths are maximum bounds for the named article layout. The general 6.5 × 8 inch figure-size recommendation is not treated as a mandatory page size. Reserve room for the caption.

TIFF/PDF are preferred chemical-figure exports; CDX is also accepted for conversion during typesetting. Other general artwork formats need manual review. Verify embedded fonts and RGB color in the exported file.
Line art requires at least 1000 dpi, grayscale/color 300 dpi. The separate black-and-white category is 500 dpi; export advisories conservatively use 1000 dpi for chemical line art.
